name: Vallewida
source:
Another prisoner at the same jail as [url=/c10893]Guys[/url], Vallewida was a soldier. He came to oppose the ways of the army, and escaped. Given that fleeing from duty is a crime, Vallewida was arrested and detained, but the interests of those who arrested him lie closer to the "army secrets" he supposedly holds... He seems to always have wounds.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
